director_disposition: DONE — 7 benchmarks established, 2 baselines documented, clear pass/fail thresholds for legal-distance lane. No further evaluation-only cycles needed until legal-distance produces candidate representations.

tfidf_reasoning_baseline.note: TF-IDF reasoning-only baseline on 1,200 BGer decisions. Fails all legal-quality metrics.

neural_multilingual_baseline.note: sentence-transformers/paraphrase-multilingual-mpnet-base-v2 (768-dim) on 1,000 BGer decisions. Hierarchy coherence tested against 4 branch labels (matching TF-IDF methodology). Beats TF-IDF on hierarchy purity, corpus stability, multilingual separation. Fails citation proximity, neighbor relevance, legal-area clustering, multilingual invariance.

comparison.critical_finding: Neural embeddings have very high cross-language similarity (0.87) but negative separation (-0.06), meaning language still dominates over legal area. Hierarchy coherence NMI=0.067 (vs TF-IDF 0.028) shows modest improvement but both fail the >0.3 target. Citation proximity and neighbor relevance remain the critical gaps for legal-specific representations.
